code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated basophils and monocytes, increased creatinine, hyperchloremia, low total protein, elevated ferritin, and a slightly increased INR. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic inflammation/infection, impaired oxygenation, mild renal dysfunction, and possible bone marrow suppression. Correlation with clinical context is recommended for further evaluation and management.
